title: The Trees That Let Go
intro: This quiz follows Zara and Eli as they learn why deciduous trees shed their leaves and prepare for winter.

choices: A tree that never grows leaves
A tree that sheds its leaves each year
A tree that grows only in deserts
A tree that stays green throughout every season
questions.explanation: A deciduous tree sheds its leaves each year.

questions.prompt: Which group contains only deciduous trees mentioned in the story?
choices: Pine, fir, spruce, cedar, and redwood
Oak, maple, elm, ash, and birch
Palm, cactus, bamboo, and fern
Apple, orange, lemon, and coconut
questions.explanation: Oak, maple, elm, ash, and birch are deciduous trees mentioned in the story.

questions.prompt: Why do deciduous trees drop their leaves before winter?
choices: To attract more insects
To save water and energy during the cold season
To make their branches longer
To stop their roots from growing
questions.explanation: Deciduous trees drop their leaves before winter to save water and energy during the cold season.

questions.prompt: What conditions make it harder for trees to keep their leaves during winter?
choices: Stronger sunlight and more water
Longer days and warmer air
Weaker sunlight and less available water
More flowers and insects
questions.explanation: Weaker sunlight and less available water make it harder for trees to keep their leaves during winter.

questions.prompt: What was resting inside the tiny buds on the branches?
choices: The beginnings of next spring's leaves
Small insects waiting for summer
Pieces of fallen bark
Drops of rainwater
questions.explanation: The tiny buds held the beginnings of next spring's leaves.
